name: Properidine
summary: Properidine is an opioid, an analgesic, and the isopropyl analog of pethidine. Properidine is under international control and is listed in the United States under the Controlled Substances Act (1970) as a Schedule I substance. It is a narcotic, with an Administrative Controlled Substances Code Number (ACSCN) of 9644 and a 2 gramme annual aggregate manufacturing quota as of 2014.88.

pharmacology.en: It is thought to act mainly as an agonist at the mu-opioid receptor, the same target as morphine. This relieves pain and causes euphoria and sedation, but also slows breathing.
pharmacology.zh: 一般認為它主要是 μ 鴉片受體的促效劑，作用目標和嗎啡相同。這會止痛並帶來欣快感和鎮靜，但也會抑制呼吸。
pharmacology.zhHans: 一般认为它主要是 μ 鸦片受体的促效剂，作用目标和吗啡相同。这会止痛并带来欣快感和镇静，但也会抑制呼吸。

uses.en: It was never marketed as a medicine and is a controlled drug in many countries.
uses.zh: 它從未作為藥物上市，在許多國家屬於管制藥物。
uses.zhHans: 它从未作为药物上市，在许多国家属于管制药物。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Opioids of this kind cause drowsiness, nausea, constipation and itching, and in overdose can slow or stop breathing, which can be fatal. Regular use leads to dependence and withdrawal.
sideEffects.zh: 人們對它在人體的作用所知甚少。這類鴉片類藥物會引起嗜睡、噁心、便秘和搔癢，過量時可能使呼吸變慢甚至停止，可能致命。規律使用會導致依賴和戒斷症狀。
sideEffects.zhHans: 人们对它在人体的作用所知甚少。这类鸦片类药物会引起嗜睡、恶心、便秘和搔痒，过量时可能使呼吸变慢甚至停止，可能致命。规律使用会导致依赖和戒断症状。

fact.en: Properidine is pethidine with its ethyl ester swapped for an isopropyl ester. Pethidine itself was first made in 1939 by Otto Eisleb in Germany, who was looking for an anticholinergic drug.
fact.zh: Properidine 是把配西汀的乙酯換成異丙酯。配西汀本身由德國的 Otto Eisleb 於 1939 年首次合成，他當時原本在尋找抗膽鹼藥物。
fact.zhHans: Properidine 是把配西汀的乙酯换成异丙酯。配西汀本身由德国的 Otto Eisleb 于 1939 年首次合成，他当时原本在寻找抗胆碱药物。
